climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: Minnesota's first American Viticultural Area, in Douglas County, ringed by six freshwater lakes. It covers about 10,880 acres in a cold plant hardiness zone of 4a to 4b. Minnesota's most planted grapes are cold-hardy varieties such as Frontenac, Marquette and La Crescent.
